model: Dialog and alert dialog overlays faded while the panel scaled from 0.95 and slid into place. animate-in is 150ms in the app stylesheets. Those enter and exit animations are gone. The panel still sits at the center.

noise.rule: 9 is round(150ms * 60 / 1000). The duration-200 class sets transition time and does not override animation-duration here, because tailwindcss-animate is not installed. Open and close each pay the same 9 frames. Not a sampled compositor trace.
